notes.title: POSTHASTE EMPORIUM: Update 1.2 Changelog & Major Fix
notes.notes:
Fixed fatal error preventing game launch if fixed.

Bug Fixes


 Fixed issue with players not being able to receive Fortuitous Fortnighter Achievement.
 Fixed issue with players not being able to receive Potion Of Recognition Achievement.
 Fixed issue with players not being able to receive I Put A Spell On You Achievement.


Visual Changes


 Added various clutter to environment


Gameplay Changes


 Adjusted store layout in order to remove a dead end and improve overall flow.
 Lowered the force in which potions will be launched out of the cauldron.
